scopes.openprofile:edit: Edit the profile at /c/profiles that is yours: claim it, correct it, set its handle.
scopes.billing:subscribe: Start a Premium or Pro term for the account that is yours: the answer is the checkout page to finish on.
scopes.billing:cancel: End the running Premium or Pro term of the account that is yours, today, with nothing refunded.
scopes.account:export: Read everything the account that is yours holds, as one JSON document.
scopes.account:delete: Ask for the account that is yours to be deleted; a link to the account email confirms it.
